Case: User completes full end-to-end signup flow from email entry through onboarding checklist
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has no existing account. All features (P0-2, P0-3, P0-5) are active.
  • Source: [CROSS-TICKET · sleekflow-login-signup-002, 003, 006, 007, 008]
  • Traceability: Full state cascade: signup identifier → password → email verification → company setup (6 steps) → onboarding landing with checklist.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to signup page, enter a valid work email, accept terms, click Sign up.
  2. Enter full name and a valid password on the password step, click Sign up.
  3. Verify email via code or link.
  4. Complete all 6 company setup steps (company name, industry, goal, channel, apps, contact).
  5. Observe the onboarding landing page.
Expected:
• Each step transition succeeds without error.
  • Email verification screen appears after signup.
  • Company setup page loads after verification.
  • All 6 setup steps can be completed.
  • Onboarding checklist with trial banner is displayed after setup.
  • User has Admin role and 7-day Pro trial.
Tags: positive, sanity, regression, integration, onboarding, auth
BDD: Given a new user starts the signup flow, When they complete email entry, password, verification, and all 6 setup steps, Then they land on the onboarding checklist with Admin role and Pro trial

Case: Social signup user reaches company setup after Google OAuth consent
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has no existing SleekFlow account. Google OAuth is configured.
  • Source: [CROSS-TICKET · sleekflow-login-signup-004, 007, 008]
  • Traceability: Social signup → (skip email verification for verified Google email) → company setup → onboarding.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to signup page.
  2. Click "Continue with Google".
  3. Complete Google OAuth consent.
  4. Observe if the user is redirected to company setup (skipping email verification).
  5. Complete company setup steps.
  6. Observe onboarding landing.
Expected:
• Google OAuth redirects back to SleekFlow.
  • Email verification is skipped (Google-verified email).
  • Company setup page loads.
  • Onboarding checklist is displayed after setup completion.
Tags: positive, sanity, regression, integration, onboarding, auth
BDD: Given a user signs up via Google OAuth, When OAuth succeeds, Then they proceed directly to company setup and onboarding without email verification

Case: Password reset flow allows login with new credentials and existing workspace access
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has a verified account with completed setup. User has forgotten their password.
  • Source: [CROSS-TICKET · sleekflow-login-signup-009, 001]
  • Traceability: Password reset → login with new password → access existing workspace.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to login page and click "Forgot password".
  2. Enter the registered email and submit.
  3. Complete the password reset via email link/code.
  4. Login with the new password.
  5. Verify the existing workspace and data are accessible.
Expected:
• Password reset email is received.
  • New password is accepted.
  • Login with new password succeeds.
  • Existing workspace dashboard loads with prior data intact.
BDD: Given a user resets their password, When they login with the new password, Then they access their existing workspace with all data intact

Case: Disposable email blocked at signup never reaches verification or setup stages
Description:
• Pre-condition: P0-3 disposable email blocking is active.
  • Source: [CROSS-TICKET · sleekflow-login-signup-002, 006, 007]
  • Traceability: Disposable email should be blocked before account creation — no verification email sent, no setup reachable.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to signup page.
  2. Enter a disposable email (e.g., test@yopmail.com), accept terms, click Sign up.
  3. Complete password step if reached.
  4. Check if verification screen or company setup is reached.
Expected:
• Signup is denied with disposable email error message.
  • No verification email is sent to the disposable address.
  • Company setup page is never reached.
  • No account record is created.
BDD: Given a user attempts signup with a disposable email, When the blocking check runs, Then no account is created and no downstream steps are reachable
